title: No Fog – Clear View
description: Removes fog in the Overworld, Nether and End for a clear, long-distance view — spot structures, biomes and players from far away, with an FPS boost. Lightweight, client-side, no OptiFine or Sodium.
body:
# No Fog

See the whole world. **No Fog** removes the fog in every dimension (Overworld, Nether and End) so you can spot structures, biomes, mobs and players from far away — with a nice FPS boost.

## What it does

- Removes distance fog in all dimensions
- Changes no blocks, items or gameplay
- Often improves FPS
- Works client-side, single-player and servers
- No mods, OptiFine, or Sodium

## Compatibility

The universal release supports the Minecraft versions listed on this page, including the latest releases, and works in vanilla alongside Sodium or OptiFine.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Go to **Options -> Resource Packs**.
3. **Open Pack Folder**, drop in the ZIP.
4. Enable it. Do not unzip.

## FAQ

**Does it work underwater and in the Nether?** Yes — fog is removed in all dimensions.
